name: Albatron Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Albatron Technology Co., Ltd manufactures and sells memory modules, motherboards, graphics cards, and other electronic components and materials in Asia, North America, and internationally. It also offers memory products; rack, GPU, storage, blades, and tiwn server, as well as servers/workstations; laptops and mini-PCs; Intel servers; storage devices; memory products; Acer products; WPS Office products; and AI application products. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
